title: White with silver curtains
text: White with silver curtains. My 20 year mini blinds finally gave up and I found myself without curtains for my bedroom.  I purchased them as a temporary window cover and a really long tension rod.  In all honesty, I love them so much I may keep them up.  I purchased the white/silver - it's really a light beige with silver lines and dots.  They have a white felt like back which is supposed to be the "blackout" part - but if you're looking for a total block of all light - these aren't it.  A very faint amount of light does come through.  For me, that is actually perfect.  I don't want a full block of light.  The silver metallic touches are subtle and very pretty - reflecting light very softly - which to me, just adds to the elegance in my opinion.  The loops are a silver metal and easily slipped onto the extra, extra long tension rod I purchased.  Because the loops are metal, they slide really easily along the tension rod. If I could change ONE thing- I wish the metal loops were not quite as shiny as they are - more a brushed nickel look. The shiny silver metal is the only thing I don't love love - but not enough for me to change my mind on the purchase.  I love the look so much that I really think I will keep them even after my mini blinds (4-6 weeks out!) are installed.  In fact, I'm thinking about purchasing 2 more sets for the living and dining area.  I tossed them in the dryer on extra low for about 5 minutes and that smoothed out the slight wrinkles right out.  The material seems to resist wrinkles over all.  I just need a proper curtain rod and it will be a very lovely mini blind window cover.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Deconovo Blackout Kitchen Curtains, 45 Inch Length, Pack of 2 - Thermal Insulated Curtains, Dots Pattern, Curtains for Dining Room (38 x 45 Inch, Baby Pink, Set of 2)
features: DESIGN and TEXTURE - Deconovo blackout curtain are made of 100 percent high quality polyester fabric. Imported, each blackout curtain panel has a foil printed wave lines with dots pattern and they are silky, soft, drapery and soft to the touch

BLACKOUT EFFECT - These room darkening curtains obstruct the sunlight from getting into any room at any time. Added to the light blocking functions, these curtain drapes provide utmost privacy as they are not see-through

ENERGY SAVING FUNCTION - Our thermal insulated curtains help in saving on energy cost as they reduce the amount of heat lost in cooler months and reflect heat in the summer. These insulating curtains are sound barrier that reduce noise from busy streets or noisy neighbors

BASIC INFORMATION - The decorative blackout curtains come in a set of 2 panels, each measuring 38Wx45L inch and no matching tie backs. With 6 stainless silver grommets per panel measuring 1.6 inch inner diameter each, these curtains are available in various colors and sizes
CARE INSTURCTIONS - For convenience, recommended hand wash. Wash below 86F. Do not bleach and do not tumble dry, warm iron. Do not use fabric softener to protect the fabric
